en: But nearly nine in ten agent deployments fail — and the cause is almost never model quality. It is undefined criteria, data that never arrives, and permissions that were never clean.

en: Each engine has its own agents, KPIs and autonomy level — but they share one customer-data layer and one knowledge layer.

vi: Quy trình “một gốc — nhiều nhánh”: một nội dung gốc mỗi tuần thành 8–15 mảnh phân phối đa nền tảng, có kiểm duyệt bắt buộc trước khi đăng.
en: The “one root — many branches” process: one original piece a week becomes 8–15 fragments distributed across platforms, with mandatory review before publishing.

vi: Chuyển từ tối ưu thứ hạng sang tối ưu để được mô hình AI trích dẫn. Phễu tám tầng, mỗi tầng một agent.
en: Shifting from optimising for rank to optimising to be cited by AI models. An eight-stage funnel, one agent per stage.

en: A single source of truth every agent reads and writes. Lifecycle playbooks from new lead to win-back, with clear human boundaries.
